knowledge_rules: Do not expose late-24th-century political borders, Dominion War geography or Voyager Delta Quadrant route data.
Later-known systems may physically exist in World Truth but remain absent or low-confidence in player charts.
Do not expose DS9-era Bajoran wormhole strategic knowledge before discovery.
Do not expose Voyager-derived Delta Quadrant route knowledge.
Bajoran wormhole knowledge becomes available only after its discovery date and according to campaign continuity.
Delta Quadrant knowledge may be ship-local, delayed, incomplete or unavailable to Alpha Quadrant actors depending on date and communications state.
Dominion War borders and fronts are initialized only if campaign start date reaches the relevant historical state.

universal_rules: Initialize physical World Truth independently from what the player database knows.
Apply political overlays after physical locations load.
Apply character/ship chart knowledge after political state loads.
After campaign start, live discoveries and political changes override future screen chronology.
